label: File type
styles.font: 14px "IsDead Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

label: Select pages
styles.font: 14px "IsDead Plus Jakarta Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

captures.aria:
- dialog "Download design":
  - region "Download":
    - button "Back to sharing"
    - text: Download
    - button "Close download": ×
    - paragraph: Page 3 of 3
    - group:
      - text: File type
      - combobox "File type":
        - option "PNG — Suggested"
        - option "JPG"
        - option "SVG" [selected]
        - option "PDF Standard"
        - option "PDF Print"
        - option "Microsoft PowerPoint — not available yet" [disabled]
        - option "MP4 Video — not available yet" [disabled]
        - option "GIF — not available yet" [disabled]
      - paragraph: Vector artwork. Text uses fonts installed on the device that opens it.
      - text: Size
      - status: 1×
      - slider "Size": "1"
      - text: 1,920 × 1,080 px
      - checkbox "Transparent background"
      - text: Transparent background Select pages
      - combobox "Select pages":
        - option "All pages (3)"
        - option "This page (3)"
        - option "Custom pages" [selected]
      - text: Page numbers
      - textbox "Page numbers":
        - /placeholder: e.g. 1, 3-5
        - text: 3, 1
      - paragraph: 2 pages selected · ZIP download
      - checkbox "Save download settings"
      - text: Save download settings Files are generated on your device.
    - button "Download"
